scenes.supernova_script:
Karthik says: Whenever I have to speak English in an interview, my brain goes into slow motion. Are my career dreams just over?
Miss Nova says: Not at all! I am Miss Nova. If you practice speaking with me, you will start speaking English confidently.
Karthik says: Really? An AI teacher? Can you actually explain things so I understand?
Miss Nova says: Of course! I explain the logic in your own language, so you never feel lost. Are you ready?
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks with relatable slow-motion English anxiety and high-stakes interview scenario.
- Introduces Miss Nova and names English early.
- Lands beat g (logic explained in your language).
